moderation.blockExplanation: Blocking works both ways: neither of you will see the other in search, suggestions, follower lists or on each other’s profile, and any follow between you is removed.
moderation.blockLinkCaveat: Links you already shared keep working for whoever holds them. Revoke the link itself to stop that.
moderation.unblockExplanation: They will be able to find and follow you again. The follows removed by the block are not restored.
moderation.reportReceipt: Your report was recorded. Reports are reviewed as moderation is built out; you will not get an update on this one.
moderation.queueScope: Every report filed in the app, newest first. Opening a report’s subject is recorded, the same as any other action here.
moderation.accessNote: You see reported content under the same privacy rules as any other member. A profile, routine or workout you would not otherwise be able to open is not shown here either.
moderation.withheldNote: You cannot open this under the privacy rules that apply to you.
moderation.withheldActionsNote: You can still dismiss the report or hide the content on what the report says.
moderation.missingNote: This no longer exists. Dismissing is all that is left.
moderation.hideExplanation: Hiding removes this from everyone else. The owner keeps it and can still see it, nothing is deleted, and you can restore it later.
moderation.restoreExplanation: Restoring makes this visible again under its own privacy settings. The hide stays in the record; restoring is added to it rather than replacing it.
moderation.recordNote: Every action below was recorded when it happened and cannot be edited or removed.
moderation.otherReports: {count, plural, one {# other report about this is still open} other {# other reports about this are still open}}
moderation.routineHidden: A moderator has hidden this routine. Nobody else can open it, including through a link you shared. It is unchanged and still yours, and its own visibility setting applies again if it is restored.
moderation.sessionShareHidden: A moderator has hidden this shared workout, so the link opens for nobody. The link is not revoked and the workout is unchanged.

moderationPage.title: Moderation
moderationPage.openFailedBody: {message} Opening reported content is recorded, so it was not opened.
moderationPage.noneWaiting: No reports are waiting. Nothing here needs a decision.

reviewAction.dismissDescription: The report leaves the queue and nothing happens to the content. The reporter is not told either way, which is what they were told when they filed it.
reviewAction.recorded: The action was recorded and cannot be edited.
reviewAction.noteCounter: {length}/{max} · Kept in the record. Neither the reporter nor the owner is shown it.

memberModeration.unblockedBody: @{handle} can find and follow you again.
memberModeration.blockedBody: You and @{handle} no longer see each other.
